from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCauseMap(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single document relevant to cause classification."""
    doc_title: str = Field(description="The title of the document, e.g., '《判决文书 X》'")
    cause_label: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action from the task list that this document belongs to")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCauseMap]
